title: Lead Network Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Lead Network Engineer operates the company’s internal data communications systems, including LANs and WANs. This role plans, designs, and implements networked systems, including configurations, supporting and troubleshooting network problems, and coordinating with vendors for installation of routers, bridges, concentrators, and switches. The Lead Network Engineer works on project implementation, provides training, assists with proposal writing, and conducts project planning, cost analysis, and vendor comparisons.
   

  

 All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement deployments spanning private data centers and public cloud environments, emphasizing infrastructure as code network connectivity for Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure.
* Provide senior technology leadership in network architecture, network automation, and public cloud environments.
* Contribute to network architecture strategy for Private/Hybrid/Public Cloud adoption, collaborating with stakeholders, partners, and customers.
* Architect, design, and deliver innovative solutions to enable public cloud connectivity with private data centers.
* Develop standard automation templates for deployment of public cloud infrastructure and platform components.
* Use cloud\-native approaches for solutions based on business goals, objectives, and requirements, while integrating with legacy solutions.
* Design security into all projects and processes for design, implementation, and operational stages.
* Provide knowledge transfer to engineering and operations teams on architecture, design, and delivery of public cloud solutions.
* Drive software development for Infrastructure as Code (IAC) efforts across Private/Hybrid/Multi Cloud environments.
* Influence enterprise technology selection and define High Level Design documentation for key technology initiatives.
* Collaborate with network engineering, cyber security, and operations teams.
* Make recommendations on next\-generation capabilities to support new business opportunities.
* Drive coordination, consensus, and execution to mitigate cyber risk issues and emerging threats.


 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Basic Qualifications:
   

  

* 10\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 7 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 4 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 13\+ years of relevant work experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 8\-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6\+ years of work experience with a PhD
* BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Science, or Math
* 4\+ years experience in cloud networking (public, private, hybrid/multi cloud) technologies, particularly AWS, Azure, GCP.
* 2\+ years of proven experience with GCP and/or Azure including design and implementation of enterprise\-level solutions
* Experience in designing and implementing networked systems for LANs and WANs.
* Experience in network automation and infrastructure as code technologies.
* Experience in public cloud environments (Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, AWS).
* Experience in developing automation templates for cloud infrastructure.
* Experience in integrating cloud\-native solutions with legacy systems.
* Experience in designing secure, scalable, repeatable, and highly available network solutions.
* Experience in providing technical leadership and knowledge transfer to engineering teams.
* Experience in software development for Infrastructure as Code (IAC).
* Experience in collaborating with cross\-functional teams (network engineering, cyber security, operations)..
* Demonstrated experience with hands\-on Infrastructure as Code (IaC) development and deployment in Hybrid Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) environments.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience in developing Terraform and Terragrunt frameworks for automated hybrid cloud deployments.
* Demonstrated experience with open\-source infrastructure as code software and automation software development tools (Terraform, Terragrunt, env0, Ansible, Python, Chef, Puppet, Salt).
* Recent experience in modern networking architecture practice including network design/operations for campus, DC, and WAN environments leveraging leading networking technologies across multi\-vendor deployments (Arista, Cisco, Juniper, Dell).
* Experience with networking tooling applications and networking ancillary services.
* Experience with networking best practices, particularly networking security best practices, firewalling/VPN experience.
* Advanced certifications a plus: CCDE, CCIE/CCNP (R\&S or SP/Security), AWS certified advanced networking, AWS certified solution architect, MS\-Azure certified solutions architect, etc..


**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Wi-Fi/DOCSIS Network Engineer
description:
* Languages: C (expert), C\+\+ (proficient); Python for tooling/automation; Shell scripting.
* Platforms: Linux (Yocto/OpenWrt\-like build systems), RTOS (FreeRTOS/ThreadX or equivalent).
* Frameworks/Stacks: RDK/RDK‑B, Docsis (preferably 3\.1/4\.0\), SNMP, TR‑369 (USP), TR‑069 (nice to have).
* Networking: Wi‑Fi (802\.11ac/ax/be), TCP/IP, VLAN, QoS, NAT, firewall, routing, policy\-based failover.
* Drivers/Middleware: GPIO/I2C/SPI/USB, LED/FAN control, audio subsystems, diagnostics, logging.
* Toolchains \& Build: GCC/Clang, CMake/Make, cross\-compilers, JTAG/UART, bootloader (U‑Boot), BSP/HAL.
* Version Control \& CI: Git, GitLab/GitHub CI, artifact management, automated unit/integration tests.
* Quality \& Reliability: Profiling, memory/performance optimization, watchdogs, crash analysis, core dumps.
* System Architecture: Module boundaries, IPC, threading/concurrency, resource management.
* Design, develop, and port RDK/RDK‑B or vendor SDK modules on routers/modems across different OEMs.
* Implement C/C\+\+ control services for LED, USB, FAN, and system state displays for cable modems/routers.
* Develop RTOS modules/drivers, SNMP interfaces, SSH/Telnet support, and voice/audio features.
* Build data control modules for Wi‑Fi 7 routers including cellular backup orchestration.
* Design TR‑369 (USP) based data collection/telemetry modules and define robust data models.
* Own system architecture, performance tuning (CPU/memory/latency), and reliability (watchdogs, crash dumps).
* Collaborate with hardware, QA, and cloud/DevOps teams for manufacturing tests, CI/CD, and field telemetry.
* Write high\-quality design docs, test plans, and release notes; participate in code reviews and certification prep.
* Troubleshoot field escalations and drive root cause analysis across firmware, drivers, and network stack layers.


 Nice\-to\-Have / Preferred:
   

  

* Wi‑Fi 7 expertise: MLO, 320 MHz channels, multi‑RU scheduling, AFC (where applicable).
* Experience with cellular modems (LTE/5G), failover and bonding, multipath.
* RDK telemetry adapters, USP controllers/agents, vendor data model mapping.
* Rust for systems modules (safety\-critical or performance\-sensitive components).
* Exposure to OpenWrt, prplOS/prplMesh, EasyMesh, and board bring‑up.
* Manufacturing line support: factory calibration, RF tests, firmware provisioning.
* Security: secure boot, trusted execution, key management, certificate provisioning.
* Compliance/certification: Docsis, Wi‑Fi Alliance, FCC/CE, operator acceptance test processes.

title: Network & Infrastructure Operations Engineer
description:
**Business Area:**
 IT
   

  

**Seniority Level:**
 Mid\-Senior level
   

  

**Job Description:**
 At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.
   

  

 Budget ID: 27B91018
   

  

 Our global infrastructure underpins every facet of Cloudera’s business \- from data center operations to IaaS\-delivered analytics and multi\-cloud platforms. As a Network \& Infrastructure Operations Engineer, you will be part of a high\-impact team responsible for managing, securing, and scaling our network infrastructure across private cloud, physical data centers, and multi\-cloud environments to ensure peak reliability and performance.
   

  

**As a Network Engineer you will:**
* Provision, configure, deploy, and tune Layer 2/3 networks (VLANs, subnets, routing, access control) across Cisco/Meraki, Dell, Juniper, and Palo Alto firewalls for cloud, data center, lab, and office environments.
* Maintain high\-capacity links (10 GbE – 100 GbE), routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), throughput, and capacity dashboards while proactively resolving network bottlenecks to hit strict uptime targets.
* Automate repetitive network operations, provisioning, and change management using Ansible, Python, and Terraform to build reproducible workflows.
* Multi\-level troubleshooting (physical, logical, cloud edge) for incident triage and resolution (including P1/P2 events).
* Maintain operational runbooks, precise network topology diagrams, capacity plans, and change management records to support cross\-functional engineering, SRE, InfoSec and Infrastructure Operations teams.
* Partner with InfoSec to manage certificates/keys, enforce firewall policies, remediate switch vulnerabilities, and support physical data center operations (OS upgrades, switching/routing configurations).


**We are excited about you if you have:**
* Relevant technical studies or a BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on enterprise, data center, or cloud network operations experience (L2/L3, Ethernet, VLAN, STP, BGP/OSPF, VPNs, routing, and switching).
* Experience managing enterprise network vendors (Cisco/Meraki, Dell, Juniper) and Palo Alto firewalls, including traffic analysis and security hardening.
* Strong foundation in Linux networking fundamentals (bridges, bonding, iptables, namespaces), paired with hands\-on experience in Kubernetes networking (CNIs, service mesh, ingress), OpenStack networking, and awareness of distributed storage connectivity (e.g., Ceph).
* Proficiency with automation tools such as Python, Ansible, or Terraform.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud infrastructure in AWS, Azure, or GCP (VPCs, Direct Connect/ExpressRoute, Transit Gateway).
* Familiarity with network monitoring, alerting tools, diagnostic dashboards, and troubleshooting.
* Clear technical communication, strong documentation skills and available on\-call when needed.


**You may also have:**
* Advanced Routing: Expertise in BGP route policy and AS path filtering.
* Industry Certifications: CCNA, CCNP, PCNSE, or relevant public cloud networking certifications.


 This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.
   

  

**What you can expect from us:**
* Generous PTO Policy
* Support work life balance with Unplugged Days
* Flexible WFH Policy
* Mental \& Physical Wellness programs
* Phone and Internet Reimbursement program
* Access to Continued Career Development
* Comprehensive Benefits and Competitive Packages
* Paid Volunteer Time
* Employee Resource Groups


 EEO/VEVRAA

title: Network Operations Engineer
description:
Join
 **Teciem** 
 , a global fintech company delivering cutting\-edge
 **Treasury \& Capital Markets software solutions** 
 to financial institutions worldwide.
 



 We're looking for a talented
 **Site Reliability Engineer** 
 who is passionate about building resilient, scalable, and high\-performing systems. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 The
 **Network Operations Engineer (NetOps)** 
 is responsible for the design, delivery, and day\-2 operations of the network layer underpinning Kondor UP. This is a
 **hands\-on, infrastructure\-focused role** 
 at the intersection of cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, and platform security \- operating within a production\-grade financial services environment.
 



 The NetOps Engineer works closely with the
 **InfraOps** 
 ,
 **SRE** 
 , and
 **SecOps** 
 teams, and is a key contributor to the
 **Network \& IAM workstream** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Network Architecture \& VPC Design** 



* Design, provision, and maintain
 **per\-tenant VPCs** 
 (3\-tier: public / private app / private data subnets) on AWS, ensuring full isolation between tenant accounts.
* Define and enforce CIDR allocation policies and subnet sizing across the multi\-account AWS Organization.
* Manage
 **VPC Endpoints** 
 (Gateway and Interface) to route AWS API traffic off the public internet.
* Contribute to architecture decisions (ADRs) on network topology, routing, and segmentation.



**2\. Hybrid Connectivity \- Bank Client Onboarding** 



* Provision and operate
 **AWS Direct Connect** 
 connections (primary) and
 **Site\-to\-Site VPN** 
 tunnels (failover) per customer tenant.
* Coordinate with client bank network teams for BGP configuration, IP addressing, and bandwidth planning.
* Define and enforce routing policies (BGP, static routes) between client on\-prem and AWS tenant environments.
* Own failover testing and validation for hybrid connectivity paths.



**3\. Network Security** 



* Configure and manage
 **AWS Network Firewall** 
 (stateful/stateless rules, Suricata\-based IDS/IPS).
* Manage
 **AWS WAF** 
 policies (OWASP rule sets, API protection, bot mitigation, rate limiting).
* Design and maintain
 **Security Groups** 
 and
 **Network ACLs** 
 following least\-privilege principles.
* Enforce
 **Kubernetes NetworkPolicy** 
 rules via
 **Kyverno** 
 for pod\-to\-pod and namespace traffic control.
* Support the SecOps team during security incidents involving network\-layer indicators.



**4\. Service Mesh \& Internal Connectivity** 



* Operate and troubleshoot
 **Istio** 
 (service mesh) for mTLS enforcement, traffic routing, and east\-west observability within EKS clusters.
* Manage
 **AWS PrivateLink** 
 endpoints for cross\-account service exposure (shared services → tenant accounts).
* Ensure network\-level connectivity for platform services:
 **Amazon MSK** 
 (Kafka),
 **Amazon MQ** 
 (ActiveMQ),
 **RDS SQL Server** 
 (Multi\-AZ).



**5\. DNS Management** 



* Manage
 **Amazon Route 53** 
 \- public hosted zones (customer\-facing endpoints), private hosted zones (internal service resolution), and resolver rules for hybrid DNS.
* Implement and validate DNS failover policies aligned with RTO/RPO targets.



**6\. Infrastructure as Code** 



* Own Terraform modules for all network resources: VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, Network Firewall policies, WAF rules, Direct Connect/VPN, and DNS zones.
* Contribute to the AFT (Account Factory for Terraform) customisation templates for network baseline provisioning on new tenant account creation.
* Enforce IaC quality standards: peer\-reviewed PRs, policy\-as\-code (Kyverno / OPA/Conftest), automated drift detection.



**7\. Observability \& Incident Response** 



* Instrument network\-layer observability:
 **VPC Flow Logs** 
 ,
 **AWS Network Firewall alerts** 
 ,
 **Istio traffic metrics** 
 (golden signals), and Direct Connect performance dashboards.
* Define and monitor network SLIs (packet loss, latency, throughput per tenant path) contributing to the SRE error budget framework.
* Act as network SME during P1/P2 incidents and post\-mortem investigations.
* Maintain network runbooks and escalation procedures in the operational knowledge base.



**8\. Capacity \& Cost Management** 



* Model bandwidth requirements per tenant and across the shared connectivity backbone; proactively plan capacity headroom.
* Optimise network costs (NAT Gateway egress, Direct Connect port utilisation, data transfer) in alignment with the FinOps workstream.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 




**8\+ years of relevant experience** 




  





**Cloud Networking \- AWS (mandatory)** 



* Deep, hands\-on experience with
 **AWS VPC** 
 (subnets, routing, peering, endpoint services, CIDR management).
* Proven
 **AWS Direct Connect** 
 deployment and operations: Virtual Interfaces (Private VIF / Transit VIF), hosted connections, BGP, failover with VPN.
* **AWS Network Firewall** 
 and
 **AWS WAF** 
 \- rule authoring, policy lifecycle, alert tuning.
* **Amazon Route 53** 
 \- advanced DNS management (private zones, resolver endpoints, health checks, failover policies).
* AWS Control Tower / multi\-account organisation networking patterns (hub\-and\-spoke, landing zone).



**Network Fundamentals** 



* Strong foundational knowledge:
 **TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, MPLS** 
 concepts, subnetting, routing.
* Experience with
 **SD\-WAN** 
 or hybrid WAN architectures is a plus.
* Familiarity with network security concepts: stateful inspection, IDS/IPS, zero\-trust network access (ZTNA).



**Kubernetes \& Service Mesh** 



* Working knowledge of
 **Kubernetes networking** 
 (CNI, kube\-proxy, CoreDNS, NetworkPolicy).
* Practical experience with
 **Istio** 
 (VirtualService, DestinationRule, PeerAuthentication, mTLS).
* Familiarity with
 **Kyverno** 
 or OPA for policy\-as\-code enforcement of network controls.



**Infrastructure as Code** 



* Proficiency in
 **Terraform** 
 (modules, workspaces, remote state, provider ecosystem for AWS networking).
* Experience with GitOps workflows (PR\-based changes, ArgoCD or equivalent).
* Version control practices: branching strategies, code review, conventional commits.



**Observability** 



* Experience with
 **VPC Flow Logs** 
 , CloudWatch, and network\-layer telemetry pipelines.
* Familiarity with
 **Prometheus / Grafana** 
 for infrastructure and service mesh dashboards.
* Ability to write and maintain runbooks and post\-mortems.



**Compliance \& Security Context (desirable)** 



* Awareness of financial services network requirements:
 **SWIFT CSP** 
 ,
 **PCI\-DSS** 
 ,
 **ISO 27001** 
 , DORA (EU).
* Understanding of data residency constraints and network\-level controls for regulated environments.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Knowledge of
 **FIX protocol** 
 or market connectivity (LSEG/Reuters, Bloomberg) network patterns.
* Familiarity with
 **AWS PrivateLink** 
 and multi\-account cross\-service exposure patterns.
* Experience with
 **Chaos Engineering** 
 for network\-layer resilience testing (partition injection, latency simulation).
* AWS certifications:
 **Advanced Networking Specialty** 
 , Solutions Architect Professional.



  





**Team Context \& Reporting** 




 The NetOps Engineer reports to the
 **Cloud / Service Delivery Manager** 
 and operates within the
 **Network \& IAM workstream** 
 .
 



 Primary interfaces: \-
 **InfraOps** 
 \- joint ownership of EKS cluster networking, IaC modules, platform baseline. \-
 **SRE** 
 \- network SLI/SLO definition, error budget contribution, incident network\-layer triage. \-
 **SecOps** 
 \- co\-owns network security posture (WAF, Firewall, NetworkPolicy); feeds into SIEM pipeline. \-
 **DevOps** 
 \- supports connectivity requirements for CI/CD pipelines, ECR pull\-through, VPC Endpoints. \-
 **Client Bank Network Teams** 
 \- external stakeholder for Direct Connect / VPN onboarding.
 



  





**Why Join Kondor UP** 



* **Impact at scale** 
 : You design and operate the network backbone of a production SaaS platform serving tier\-1 financial institutions \- every routing decision you make has direct SLA consequences.
* **Modern stack** 
 : AWS\-native, Terraform\-first, GitOps, Istio, Kyverno \- no legacy on\-prem tooling debt.
* **Financial domain depth**

description:

*mids, and nights.*
 The Perimeter Security Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, administering, monitoring, and supporting enterprise perimeter security controls across on\-premises, cloud, and remote\-access environments. The role provides deep operational expertise in next\-generation firewalls and secure web proxy technologies, partners with infrastructure and application teams to resolve connectivity and policy issues, and strengthens security through disciplined change, compliance, lifecycle, and incident\-management practices.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Administer enterprise firewalls, including security policies, NAT, routing, VPN, application control, URL filtering, threat prevention, software upgrades, high availability, monitoring, auditing, and rule\-base hygiene.
* Configure, operate, and troubleshoot secure web proxy and cloud\-delivered security services, including explicit and transparent proxy, PAC files, authentication, SSL/TLS inspection, URL categorization, malware controls, and policy enforcement.
* Plan, design, implement, and validate improvements, migrations, replacements, and standardization of perimeter security components.
* Perform in\-depth troubleshooting using firewall and proxy logs, packet captures, flow analysis, threat logs, and monitoring tools to determine root cause and restore services.
* Investigate security events and indicators involving internet ingress and egress, remote access, web traffic, command\-and\-control activity, malicious downloads, and policy violations.
* Assess and implement firewall and proxy requests with appropriate business justification, least\-privilege access, application awareness, risk review, testing, and rollback planning.
* Monitor platform availability, capacity, performance, license health, certificate validity, and high\-availability status; support uptime and service\-level commitments.

 Technical Expertise

* Operations \& Tooling: ITSM and change management; SIEM and monitoring tools; configuration backup; vulnerability and compliance review; scripting or automation with Python, PowerShell, APIs, or infrastructure\-as\-code is desirable.


**What We're Looking For**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant hands\-on experience in perimeter security, with strong operational expertise in enterprise firewall and secure web proxy technologies.

* Professional experience in information security, network security, consulting, managed services, or an enterprise security operations role.

* Experience working within formal incident, problems, change, vulnerability, and configuration\-management processes.

 California Burrito is a fast\-growing QSR chain with 2500\+ employees across 140\+ locations across Bengaluru, NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai and Pune. We started in 2012 with a simple belief: no compromise, just real ingredients. Since then, we’ve been serving honestly good Mexican food while building a more wholesome, sustainable way to do fast food, including growing our own fresh ingredients. Our mission is to become India’s most recognised name in Mexican cuisine while setting the standard for quality, speed and friendly hospitality. And how we get there matters just as much. We stay Open \& Honest, Strive for Excellence, believe in Freedom with Ownership, and focus on Growing Every Day.
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We are looking for an experienced, and resourceful Manager \- IT Infrastructure (Retail \& Store Operations) to lead and oversee our store IT infrastructure and technology services across all operating locations. In this role, you will take end\-to\-end ownership of store IT operations—ensuring maximum uptime, seamless POS and network performance, robust vendor management, and scalable IT setups for our expanding store footprint.
 



  





**WHAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED?** 




 You’re self\-driven and naturally take initiative. You possess strong technical troubleshooting abilities combined with high ownership levels and people management skills. You are comfortable solving complex operational challenges, managing external partners, and coordinating seamlessly with internal operations and project teams. You think strategically, communicate effectively, and step up to lead technology readiness in a fast\-paced retail environment.
 



  





**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Diploma or B.Tech/B.E. in IT, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field.
* Proven track record in IT infrastructure and services management (experience handling multi\-unit QSR, retail, or hospitality store networks is strongly preferred).
* Deep hands\-on and managerial understanding of POS systems, billing hardware, thermal printers, and store network infrastructure (LAN, Wi\-Fi routers, SIM\-based systems).



  





**WHAT WILL YOU OWN?** 



* Store IT Infrastructure \& Support: Oversee installation, configuration, and operational uptime of POS billing systems, hardware peripherals, printers, SIM landlines, and internet connectivity across all store locations.
* Escalation \& Issue Resolution: Manage hardware/software troubleshooting workflows, maintain issue logging standards, and ensure rapid resolution for store\-level technical disruptions during operational hours.
* Vendor \& Telecom Management: Lead relationships and coordinate service delivery with third\-party IT vendors, ISPs, POS software providers, and telecom partners.
* Expansion \& Store Readiness: Partner with Operations and Projects teams to design, set up, and launch IT infrastructure for new store openings.
* Maintenance \& Continuity: Establish preventive maintenance schedules, manage backup hardware inventory, and ensure swift replacement protocols to minimize store downtime.
* Team Leadership \& Training: Drive IT support protocols, mentor team members, and implement basic IT troubleshooting training for store personnel.



  





**GET TO KNOW US BETTER** 




 Website: https://www.californiaburrito.in
 



 Instagram: www.instagram.com/californiaburrito\_in
 



  





**Corporate Office:** 




 Sapota Park 1st Main Rd, 1st Cross Rd, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038

title: Senior Analyst , Cloud Platforms Engineering
description:
**Company Overview**
 Headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, Cardinal Health, Inc. (NYSE: CAH) is a global, integrated healthcare services and products company connecting patients, providers, payers, pharmacists and manufacturers for integrated care coordination and better patient management. Backed by nearly 100 years of experience, with more than 48,000 employees in nearly 60 countries, Cardinal Health ranks among the top 20 on the Fortune 500 , America's Most Innovative Companies \#51,11 Best GCCs to work for in India, Fortune Sector Leaders : Health Care \#5, with a $254 billion. of revenue in FY26
   

  

**About Cardinal Health International India (CHII)**
 Cardinal Health International India (CHII) is part of the Cardinal Heath Global Technology and Business Services ( GTBS) team. CHII leverages technology to offer scalable and healthcare solutions to enhance efficiency and improve quality of care across the value chain. Our vision is to build a world class capability center that is an intersection of tech\-innovation and learning, empowering our people to build solutions which will solve healthcare’s most complex challenges.
   

  

 Department Overview
   

  

 The Cloud Engineer role is responsible for designing, implementing, operating and maintaining the Cardinal Health Cloud Platforms environment. This includes various operating systems and cloud platforms. Assist in Design/Architecture of GCP, AWS, Azure or other hybrid cloud solutions
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Help define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments. Troubleshoot technical issues and help drive issue escalation with other teams. Provide 24 X 7 operations for Cloud Hosting Services. Contribute and enhance Security policies, procedures and automation for Cloud Services. Implement System Management Tools to provide monitoring and management of all Cloud infrastructure. Conduct System Outage Analysis to prevent the recurrence of incidents.
   

  

 Perform Cloud Infrastructure projects or tasks in a timely manner, as assigned by Product Manager or Management. This role requires an understanding of Multi\-Cloud Platforms Technologies and Services, Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), Terraform, GitHub and IT Operations based on ITIL Framework. The role’s primary focus is to provide build and operations expertise with a high focus on automation in areas such as performance, monitoring, logging, security, backups/HA/DR, compliance, and ensure the operations processes and standards are maintained in production. Other duties include documentation and service request fulfillment.
   

  

**Other Responsibilities**
* Support Multi\-Cloud Platforms \- GCP, Azure, AWS.
* Partner with application teams and product management teams to provide support and operate cloud\-based workloads.
* Continually review and recommend improvements to operational processes, procedures and automation.
* Pursue and recommend opportunities to automate anything and everything where possible.
* Ensure Monitoring and Alerting Standards are tested in transition and followed in production.
* Ensure migrated Cloud infrastructure solutions maintain compliance with Security and Governance standards.
* Confirm the health of the service meets defined service level expectations.
* Participate in incident management and communications, including follow\-up with problem resolution post\-mortem, and process improvement.
* Support automation solutions for source, deploy, pipeline, configuration management.


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience with DevOps related automation tools and platform management services (GCP, AWS, Azure) and Terraform and GitHub
* Systems administration expertise (Windows, Linux)
* Scripting technologies (Powershell, Bash, Python)
* Enterprise Monitoring Tools for infrastructure and applications
* ITIL Foundations
* Enterprise ITSM and CMDB Tools
* Data Networks – routing, firewalls, load balancers, DNS
* Databases
* Cloud Storage architecture and technologies
* Security – Access Management, Key Management
* Cloud Architectures
* Automation in a cloud environment – Infrastructure as Code
* SDLC and Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment concepts
* Risk, Security, and Audit compliance


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 1 Year of experience with GCP, Azure and AWS, certification desired.
* 1\-2 Years of experience with Infrastructure as Code.
* 1\-2 Years of experience with monitoring enterprise systems.
* 1\-2 Years of experience in data center domains (server, network, storage, security)
* 1\-2 Years of experience with server and directory service technologies (Windows, Linux, AD, DNS)
* Excellent organizational skills, and oral and written communication skills
* Security compliance experience
* Ability to work with minimal supervision, making decisions based upon priorities, schedules and an understanding of business initiatives
* Ability to apply critical thinking to all aspects of the position
* Detail oriented with excellent documentation skills/methodologies, who is able to successfully manage multiple priorities


 Why Join Cardinal Health?
   

  

* Work for a Fortune 20 healthcare leader impacting millions of lives.
* Be part of a rapidly growing Enterprise Technology organization.
* Solve meaningful cloud challenges at global enterprise scale.
* Learn from experienced cloud platform leaders and technical experts.
* Access continuous learning, mentorship, and career development opportunities.
* Thrive in a collaborative, supportive, and innovation\-driven culture.


**Join us in transforming the future of healthcare through digital transformation while building a rewarding and impactful career.**
*Candidates who are back\-to\-work, people with disabilities, without a college degree, and Veterans are encouraged to apply.*

We celebrate the power of our differences to create better solutions for our customers by ensuring employees can be their authentic selves each day. title: Technical Specialist - MS Teams
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
   

  

 Could you be the full\-time Technical Specialist – Microsoft Teams in Bangalore we’re looking for?
   

  

**Your future role**
 Take on a new challenge and apply your expertise in Microsoft Teams administration and enterprise voice solutions in a cutting\-edge global environment. You’ll work alongside collaborative, innovative, and solution\-oriented teammates.
   

  

 You'll play a critical role in ensuring the seamless operation of Microsoft Teams and related Office 365 services for 80,000 users worldwide. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as UCC \& AD L3, Incident Management, and IT Security), liaise with external partners like Microsoft, and contribute to global\-scale live events and much more.
   

  

 You’ll specifically take care of tasks such as managing Teams devices and licenses, optimizing call quality, and driving the migration of fixed telephony to Teams Phone System, but also research and implement new features to enhance user experiences.
   

  

 We’ll look to you for:
   

  

* Collaborating with UCC Architects on Microsoft Teams implementation projects
* Managing the migration of fixed telephony to Teams Phone System
* Configuring and managing Teams video conferencing and audio devices
* Analyzing Call Quality Dashboard data to optimize user experience
* Creating and managing custom apps on Teams
* Managing Teams\-related licenses, including monthly clean\-ups
* Supporting and managing global live events
* Researching, testing, and deploying new Teams features
* Providing technical expertise to troubleshoot and resolve issues


**All About You**
 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
   

  

* Graduated B.E or B\-Tech
* 8–10 years of experience supporting Microsoft Teams
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Teams administration and architecture at an enterprise level
* Expertise in Teams Enterprise Voice, Teams Conferencing, and Live Events
* Experience with Microsoft Teams rooms (MTR) and devices like Polycom, Lenovo Smart Hubs, and Yealink
* Good understanding of VOIP protocols (SIP, RTP/RTCP, SRTP) and network configurations (DNS, DHCP)
* Proficiency in troubleshooting Teams call quality issues, including log analysis
* Familiarity with tools like Wireshark, Fiddler, and Teams monitoring/reporting tools
* Experience using PowerShell to maintain Microsoft Teams
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Ability to work in shifts and adhere to Alstom policies and procedures
* A proactive, team\-oriented mindset with excellent problem\-solving skills


**Things you’ll enjoy** 
 Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
   

  

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling and cutting\-edge technologies
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects in a global environment
* Utilise our inclusive and flexible working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning programs
* Progress towards leadership roles or advanced technical expertise
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)


 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

**Important to note**
 As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer - Splunk Admin (SIEM)
description:
**FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India), a part of First Citizens BancShares, Inc., a top 20 U.S. financial institution, is a global capability center (GCC) based in Bengaluru. Our India\-based teams benefit from the company’s over 125\-year legacy of strength and stability. First Citizens India is responsible for delivering value and managing risks for our lines of business. We are particularly proud of our strong, relationship\-driven culture and our long\-term approach, which are deeply ingrained in our talented workforce. This is evident across all key areas of our operations, including Technology, Enterprise Operations, Finance, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Credit Administration. We are seeking talented individuals to join us in our mission of providing solutions fit for our clients’ greatest ambitions.**
**Job Description**
 Job Description
   

  

**Value Proposition**
 Responsible for enterprise\-wide observability and monitoring initiative. Responsible to build, and implementing standardized data onboarding pipelines and configurations to bring applications into Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Enterprise Security platforms.
   

  

**Job Details**
 Position Title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
   

  

 Career Level: P4
   

  

 Job Category: Assistant Vice President
   

  

 Role Type: Hybrid
   

  

 Job Location: Bangalore
   

  

**About The Role**
 Seeking expert Splunk Admins for a critical enterprise\-wide observability and monitoring initiative. This role is essential in designing, building, and implementing standardized data onboarding pipelines and configurations to bring applications into Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Enterprise Security platforms. Success demands both technical depth and the ability to work at a rapid pace while maintaining high quality and consistency.
   

  

**Key Deliverables**
* Design and implement standardized data onboarding procedures and configurations for applications; establish repeatable patterns and templates
* Conduct technical onboarding of applications into Splunk Cloud: configure data inputs, create parsing rules, establish field extractions, and build data models
* Map application data and security events to Splunk Common Information Model (CIM); identify and document relevant SIEM use cases
* Build and optimize data models, lookups, and knowledge objects to support reporting, alerting, alerting rule creation, and compliance requirements
* Design and implement automated onboarding pipelines using Git\-based configuration management, Ansible playbooks, and CI/CD workflows to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* Establish and enforce standardized tagging conventions, naming standards, and data organization principles across all onboarded applications
* Collaborate with Business Analysts to translate requirements into technical specifications; support requirements clarification and feasibility assessment
* Work alongside Splunk Data Admins to execute onboarding at scale; establish code review and peer collaboration practices to maintain quality
* Provide consultation to Splunk users and stakeholder teams on best practices, use cases, and guidance for creating and maintaining knowledge objects
* Deliver training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to Enterprise Monitoring Team and partner IT teams on standardized onboarding procedures and platform capabilities
* Integrate Splunk with complementary monitoring and infrastructure platforms (Dynatrace, SolarWinds) to ensure cohesive observability workflows
* Serve as primary technical point of contact for complex Splunk platform issues during the engagement period; support incident response as needed in collaboration with client's operations team
* Monitor Splunk platform health and performance; proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks, optimization opportunities, and infrastructure constraints
* Correlate and reconcile disparate events and data sources from multiple monitoring platforms to ensure consistent, reliable alerting and reporting
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex data integration challenges; identify data quality issues, reconciliation gaps, and root causes
* Document technical architecture, configuration decisions, onboarding procedures, and lessons learned to enable knowledge transfer and future maintenance
* Participate in ongoing optimization and performance tuning as volume and complexity increase throughout the engagement


**Skills And Qualification**
* Advanced Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Cloud administration
* Strong knowledge of data models, data model accelerations, and knowledge objects
* Deep understanding of Common Information Model (CIM) and data normalization principles
* Experience with advanced search optimization, lookup tables, and automated lookups
* Proficiency with Splunk Enterprise Security (ES) platform and SIEM use cases
* Knowledge of Splunk Cloud\-specific features, limitations, and best practices
* Understanding of Splunk licensing, data ingestion pipelines, and performance tuning
* Hands\-on experience designing and implementing data ingestion pipelines
* Expertise in log parsing, data transformation, and field extraction
* Strong proficiency with Git version control and collaborative development workflows (branching, pull requests, code reviews)
* Hands\-on experience with Ansible for infrastructure automation and configuration management
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes
* Scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or similar languages
* Understanding of SIEM platforms and security event management workflows
* Knowledge of common security use cases (authentication, access control, threat detection, incident response)
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOX, PCI\-DSS, HIPAA) and audit trail requirements
* Desired to have knowledge of complementary observability platforms (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Prometheus, Elastic)
* Minimum 3\+ years of hands\-on Splunk Enterprise administration and implementation experience
* Minimum 10\+ years of infrastructure, platform engineering, systems administration, or related technical domain experience
* Splunk Certified Admin (SCA), Splunk Certified Power User (SCPU) and Splunk ES certification or coursework completed required; additional Splunk certifications (e.g., SCS, Developer) preferred
* Excellent oral and written communication skills as well as positive, customer\-focused interpersonal skills and attitude
* Excellent collaboration skills, ownership \& accountability
* Financial Services/Banking experience, Large Financial Institution (LFI) (or similarly complex environment) preferred
* BE or MCA Degree in computer science or related field


**Relationships \& Collaboration**
* Reports to: Associate Director
* Partners: Cross\-functional teams across geographies ( US team)


**Accessibility Needs**
 We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring process. If you require accommodations at any stage (e.g. application, interviews, onboarding) please let us know, and we will work with you to ensure a seamless experience.
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
**FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India) is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible environment and prohibit all forms of discrimination on the basis of gender, religion, caste, disability, sexual orientation, economic status or any other characteristics protected by the law. We strive to foster a safe and respectful environment in which all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Our EEO policy ensures fairness throughout the employee life cycle.**

We cover a wide range of operational aspects, including divestiture advisory services, carve\-out readiness and support, operational due diligence, synergy assessment and delivery, day\-one readiness assessment, 100\- day planning, integration process support, carve\-out/stand\-alone costs assessment and risks, and cost reduction. **GDS SaT – Transaction Strategy and Execution – Deal Tech (TSE IT) \- Manager, India**

 EY\-Parthenon’s GDS Transaction Strategy and Execution (TSE) Technology team helps clients with IT\-related aspects of M\&A transactions:
   

  

* IT diligence: EY\-Parthenon professionals evaluate a target's IT infrastructure \& Cyber security to help clients assess its attractiveness.

Manage engagements, problem\-solve, facilitate, ensure engagement success, and quality in delivery, Establish regular connectivity and reporting to the regional TSE partners. **Role Summary:** 




  





 The Senior Support Specialist is a senior security practitioner responsible for defending the organization’s network, infrastructure, and cloud environments against internal and external threats. This role operates at the intersection of security engineering and operations, with direct ownership of network security controls, threat detection, and incident response. Support responsibilities exist to enable security outcomes, not as an end in themselves.
 



 This position requires hands\-on expertise, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to identify systemic risk before it becomes an incident.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities:** 




  





**Network Security Ownership** 



* Architect, deploy, and continuously harden network security controls including firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, segmentation, and zero\-trust access models.
* Own network perimeter and internal trust boundaries, including firewall policy design, rule lifecycle management, and access validation.
* Actively monitor network traffic and telemetry to identify indicators of compromise, lateral movement, and policy violations.
* Lead vulnerability discovery and remediation for network and infrastructure components.



  





**Threat Detection \& Incident Response** 



* Serve as the primary escalation point for all security incidents involving network intrusion, unauthorized access, malware, or data exposure.
* Perform deep forensic analysis using logs, packet captures, and endpoint data to determine scope and impact.
* Contain, eradicate, and recover from incidents while preserving evidence and maintaining operational continuity.
* Drive post\-incident root cause analysis and ensure corrective controls are implemented, not merely documented.



  





**Security Operations Engineering** 



* Maintain and tune security tooling including SIEM, NDR, EDR/XDR, and vulnerability management platforms.
* Define detection logic, alert thresholds, and response playbooks aligned to real threat models rather than checkbox compliance.
* Reduce noise and false positives while improving time\-to\-detect and time\-to\-contain metrics.



  





**Security\-Driven Support \& Escalation** 



* Handle only the most complex escalations where security risk, system integrity, or availability is at stake.
* Enforce secure configuration standards across systems, networks, and cloud services.
* Mentor support and IT staff on secure operational practices and adversarial thinking.



  





**Risk, Governance \& Assurance** 



* Translate security policy and control requirements into enforceable technical reality.
* Support audits and assessments by producing defensible, technically accurate evidence.
* Continuously assess gaps between documented controls and actual security posture.



  





**Architecture \& Strategic Hardening** 



* Influence infrastructure and application design decisions to reduce attack surface and blast radius.

title: Infrastructure Engineer Specialist - WAF & DevSecOps Automation
description:
**Company Overview**
 At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
   

  

**Department Overview**
 The Core Platforms \& Services team is responsible for the development and operations of critical cloud infrastructure and platform services, in support of Motorola Solutions' public and hybrid cloud\-based Software as a Service (SaaS) solutions for public safety customers. This team is part of Motorola Solutions’ Software Enterprise division, which offers secure, reliable and efficient team communications, workflow and operational intelligence solutions for mission critical public safety and enterprise markets throughout the world. Our services leverage Cloud Computing infrastructure on Azure, AWS \& GCP to build at scale.
   

  

**Job Description**
**We are seeking a highly specialized
 **Infrastructure Engineer Specialist** 
 to lead our infrastructure security efforts with a primary focus on
 **WAF configuration management** 
 and building robust
 **DevSecOps automation frameworks** 
 . This role is pivotal in bridging the gap between infrastructure stability and automated security policy enforcement across our hybrid cloud environments.**
 Basic Requirements
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* WAF Configuration \& Lifecycle Management
* Advanced WAF Engineering: Lead the lifecycle of WAF solutions, moving beyond deployment to advanced configuration management, including automated rule tuning, signature lifecycle management, and high\-precision threat policy optimization to minimize false positives.
* Automated Policy Enforcement: Develop and maintain automated workflows for translating business requirements into WAF traffic policies. Implement CI/CD pipelines that push WAF configurations as code, ensuring consistent policy application across environments.
* Optimization \& Tuning: Proactively analyze WAF logs to identify and remediate complex bot traffic and sophisticated attack patterns, ensuring high availability and optimal performance.
* DevSecOps Automation Frameworks
* Security Automation Architecture: Design and deploy automated frameworks that integrate security controls directly into infrastructure provisioning. Use tools like Terraform or Ansible to enforce security baselines as part of the standard deployment lifecycle.
* Security Observability: Configure SIEM forwarding and alerts for WAF and Network logs. You are responsible for detecting anomalies (like data exfiltration attempts or unusual traffic spikes), ensuring actionable intelligence is derived from system logs.
* Pipeline Security Integration: Orchestrate the integration of automated security gates (SAST/SCA/Container Scanning) into CI/CD pipelines. Ensure that "Security as Code" is not just a concept, but an automated reality for all infrastructure deployments.
* Policy as Code (PaC): Develop and manage automated policy engines (e.g., OPA, Sentinel) to programmatically reject non\-compliant infrastructure changes before they reach production


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience: 10\+ years in Infrastructure Engineering or DevSecOps, with a significant track record in high\-traffic environments.
* Primary Tech Stack: Extensive experience in WAF configuration management (e.g., F5, Signal Sciences, CloudFront WAF) and Nginx/Kubernetes Ingress Controllers.
* Automation Expertise: Strong proficiency in building DevSecOps automation frameworks. Expert\-level skill in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and scripting (Python or Go).
* Security Mindset: Deep understanding of automated threat mitigation, policy\-as\-code principles, and cloud\-native security orchestration.
* Hybrid Expertise: Proven ability to manage and automate security policies across complex hybrid or multi\-cloud infrastructures (AWS, GCP, Azure).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Proficiency in developing custom WAF rules (iRules, ModSecurity).
* Experience with GitOps workflows for infrastructure security.
* Certifications: Certifications such as CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist) or advanced security automation credentials.

 None
   

  

 Relocation Provided
   

  

 None
   

  

 Position Type
   

  

 Experienced
   

  

 Referral Payment Plan
   

  

 No

 Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally\-protected characteristic.

description:

 Anthriq is a signal processing infrastructure company. We build the full acquisition and compute stack for human\-aware technology — from custom analog front\-end IP that captures biosignals at the source, to signal\-first compute systems.

 **anthriq.com/silicon**
**About The Role**
 Anthriq’s semiconductor design company operates an on\-premise infrastructure that includes a Nutanix hyperconverged compute and VDI cluster, an EDA compute farm, NetApp storage, Fortinet networking, and a dedicated server room, alongside a Cadence Palladium emulation environment. We are seeking an IT Infrastructure Engineer to own the day\-to\-day operation, reliability, and maintenance of this infrastructure. The role covers servers, virtualization, networking, storage, backup, and server\-room operations, and works closely with the Engineering team to support the underlying host and network requirements.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the company's complete IT infrastructure end\-to\-end.
* Administer and maintain Linux (RHEL / Rocky 9\.x) and Windows servers across the environment.
* Operate and maintain the Nutanix HCI cluster (compute, VDI, and EDA compute\-farm nodes) — provisioning, patching, monitoring, and capacity management.
* Support the Palladium host servers (OS, drivers, networking, and connectivity) in coordination with the emulation engineer.
* Manage the Fortinet switches and firewall — VLANs, routing, firewall policies, and uplink/port configuration.
* Administer NetApp / NFS storage — shares, capacity, and performance.
* Own backup and disaster\-recovery operations, including scheduling, testing, and restores.
* Handle server\-room operations — racks, PDUs, UPS, cabling, and environmental monitoring — and track power and cooling headroom as the room scales.
* Automate routine administration tasks using Bash and/or Python.
* Maintain Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and general office IT services.
* Coordinate with hardware and software vendors and support partners for incidents, warranties, and renewals.
* Maintain documentation, monitoring, and basic security hygiene (patching, access control).
* Opportunity to build the Infra team as we grow.


**Requirements**
**Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in IT infrastructure or systems and network administration. Ownership of infrastructure is preferred.
* Strong Linux administration (RHEL / Rocky) and working knowledge of Windows Server and Active Directory.
* Solid networking fundamentals — VLANs, TCP/IP, and firewall/switch administration (Fortinet experience preferred).
* Hands\-on experience with virtualization / HCI (Nutanix AHV or VMware).
* Storage administration experience (NFS / NetApp or equivalent).
* Experience implementing and testing backup and disaster\-recovery solutions.
* Scripting and automation skills in Bash and/or Python.
* Understanding of server\-room and data center operations — racks, UPS, PDU, power, and cooling.
* Ability to work independently across a broad range of technologies with strong ownership


**Good to have**
* Exposure to EDA compute farms or job schedulers (LSF, Slurm), InfiniBand, and Cadence Palladium host maintenance
* Configuration management (Ansible); monitoring tools (Zabbix/Grafana/Prometheus); relevant certifications (RHCSA/RHCE, Fortinet NSE, Nutanix NCP).

**Essential Skills / Experience** 




 • 7\+ years of hands\-on experience managing enterprise\-scale containerized infrastructure.
 



 • Strong experience across EKS, ECS, EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, and IAM.
 



 • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and ArgoCD.
 



 • Proven expertise with Terraform, Crossplane, CloudFormation, and cloud automation.

 • Expertise in Cloud FinOps practices, Cloud Engineering migrations, service onboarding and Cloud Security management and tooling

 BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. title: Principal Windows Server Infrastructure Architect (5-9 years), Bangalore
description:
**Job Description**
 As the Windows Server Infrastructure Architect, you will own the design, architecture, and standardization of the Windows Server platform across a large\-scale environment. This is a senior engineering and architecture role — not an operations or endpoint/desktop management role. You will be the technical authority for Windows Server, responsible for building the patching architecture, gold image pipeline, deployment standards, and virtualization strategy that operations teams execute against.
   

  

 You will set direction, define standards, and solve the hardest platform\-level problems.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Deep expertise administering and architecting Windows Server (2016/2019/2022 and newer) at enterprise scale
* Proven experience designing an enterprise patching/configuration architecture for a large server fleet using SCCM/MECM (Current Branch) or a comparable enterprise tool
* Hands\-on experience building Windows Server gold images and standardized deployment/provisioning pipelines
* Strong virtualization background: Hyper\-V (preferred) and/or VMware vSphere — host design, clustering/HA, and capacity planning
* Advanced PowerShell scripting and automation; experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code and/or configuration management (DSC, Ansible, Terraform, or similar) is a strong plus
* Solid Active Directory, GPO, DNS, and Windows networking fundamentals as they apply to server infrastructure
* Experience integrating vulnerability scanners (Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7\) and applying security hardening baselines (CIS, DISA STIG)
* Ability to operate as a technical lead: set standards, produce architecture/design documentation, and guide execution teams


**General Skills \& Competencies**
* Proactive self\-starter who manages time and priorities independently
* Strong ability to translate business and security needs into comprehensive technical solutions while building credibility across teams
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to deliver formal architecture presentations to both technical teams and leadership
* Effective in one\-on\-one and group settings; able to respond well to questions in unstructured formats
* Mentors junior engineers, drives process and service improvements, and keeps current with the Windows Server and virtualization landscape


**Experience Required**
* 10\+ years in Windows Server infrastructure engineering, with a significant portion in an architecture or technical lead capacity on large\-scale (1,000\+ server) environments
* Demonstrated ownership of enterprise patching architecture, gold image pipelines, and server virtualization at scale


**Certifications Preferred**
* Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (AZ\-800/AZ\-801\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\) — for hybrid/cloud environments
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator (SC\-300\) — if AD/identity is in scope

It is comprised of three industry\-leading businesses which, combined, provide end\-to\-end solutions across the investment lifecycle.
   

  

**Overview of the Senior Cloud Platform Engineer – OCI \& Observability:**
 The Senior Cloud Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, operating, and continuously improving BetaNXT’s OCI‑based cloud platform, with a strong focus on observability, platform hygiene, capacity management, and production readiness. This role operates deeply in the technical layer of cloud infrastructure while partnering closely with Cloud Operations, DevOps, and external service providers to ensure stable, scalable, and well‑governed environments.
   

  

 The role serves as a hands‑on technical authority for OCI environments, platform cleanup, patching readiness, and monitoring architecture, while actively participating in operational governance and incident response.
   

  

**Duties and Responsibilities of the Senior Cloud Platform Engineer – OCI \& Observability:**
* Manage and improve OCI platform hygiene, including resource organization, compartment alignment, cleanup, and safe termination of unused assets, ensuring all actions follow formal change processes with clear technical guidance on execution sequencing
* Contribute to observability and monitoring architecture by supporting OCI monitoring migrations and integrating monitoring components (e.g., Alloy, node exporter, custom scripts) into environment build and bootstrapping processes to ensure consistent visibility across environments
* Support platform performance and capacity management through participation in review forums, providing insights on performance trends, scaling considerations, and enabling data\-driven decisions for long\-term platform health
* Coordinate and support production operations and maintenance activities, including scheduled outages (e.g., compute power\-offs), aligning with internal teams, vendors, and partners to ensure proper timing, coverage, and governance adherence
* Respond to and support production incidents, including middleware and messaging platforms (e.g., IBM MQ), ensuring appropriate escalation, cross\-team coordination, and post\-change validation to confirm system stability
* Strengthen patching and environment readiness by identifying gaps in testing processes, defining requirements for reliable development/test environments, and collaborating with development teams to enable safe validation of platform changes
* Participate in change governance and operational forums (e.g., Emergency CAB), ensuring all platform changes are reviewed, risks are communicated, and execution aligns with governance standards
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Cloud Operations, DevOps, Security, development teams, and external vendors, communicating clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders to support platform reliability and change execution


**Skills and Experience of the Senior Cloud Platform Engineer – OCI \& Observability:**
* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience with OCI (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure), including working directly in high\-accountability production environments
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field
* Proven experience designing, implementing, and supporting cloud observability and monitoring solutions, including large\-scale migrations or standardization efforts
* Deep expertise in cloud resource lifecycle management, platform patching and maintenance coordination, distributed system operations, and messaging/middleware platforms (e.g., IBM MQ)
* Strong ability to manage and operate complex cloud platforms, particularly in regulated or financial\-services environments
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex platform and infrastructure issues
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, especially during incidents, escalations, and complex change scenarios
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate across multiple teams, including internal engineering groups, operations, and third\-party providers (e.g., DXC)
* Strong focus on automation, standardization, and maintaining long\-term platform health and reliability
* Background in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), platform engineering, or similar infrastructure\-focused roles

The ideal candidate brings strong hands\-on Zscaler delivery experience, solid network security fundamentals, and the ability to work across security, network, IAM, and endpoint teams.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Consultant on the Cyber team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Leading and supporting the implementation, configuration, and migration of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) solutions.
* Assessing current\-state network and security architecture and designing Zero Trust access models aligned to business and security requirements.
* Planning and executing migration from legacy VPN, proxy, and remote access technologies to Zscaler platforms.
* Configuring ZIA and ZPA policies, application segmentation, connector deployment, authentication, forwarding methods, and user\-to\-application connectivity.
* Troubleshooting connectivity, performance, and policy issues and supporting pilot, rollout, cutover, and post\-migration activities.


**The team**
 Deloitte’s Cyber team helps organizations build, operate, and enhance security capabilities across identity, network, cloud, and application environments. The team works with clients to modernize security architecture, enable secure access, and support enterprise transformation through scalable, business\-aligned solutions. Professionals in this practice collaborate across cybersecurity, infrastructure, and technology stakeholders to address complex security and connectivity challenges.
   

  

**Location: Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: Regular India Shift Timing**

* 6\-9 years of experience in network security, cloud security, or enterprise security architecture.
* Experience implementing and migrating Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) in enterprise environments.
* Experience configuring ZIA security policies, including URL filtering, Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) inspection, authentication, forwarding methods, and access controls.
* Experience configuring ZPA application segmentation, connector deployment, access policies, and user\-to\-application connectivity.
* Experience integrating Zscaler with identity and security platforms, including Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), System for Cross\-domain Identity Management (SCIM), security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), or cloud access security broker (CASB) tools.
* Experience with Domain Name System (DNS), Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), routing, firewall policies, proxy technologies, and VPN migration.
* Experience creating technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, runbooks, migration plans, and operational handover materials.


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience designing Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions and remote access modernization programs.
* Experience with Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) for experience monitoring and user troubleshooting.
* Experience deploying Zscaler Client Connector and integrating with endpoint platforms.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise transformation or network security modernization programs.
* Zscaler Certified Cloud Administrator (ZCCA), Zscaler Certified Cloud Professional (ZCCP) for ZIA or ZPA, or Zscaler Certified Cloud Specialist (ZCCS).

title: NOC Senior Engineer
description:
**Company Introduction**
 Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting\-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.
   

  

 Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking an experienced NOC Senior Engineer to support 24x7 operations, major incident management, cloud infrastructure support, and operational excellence initiatives. This is a senior hands\-on role responsible for advanced technical troubleshooting, L3 escalations, proactive monitoring, automation, and ensuring the reliability and availability of critical production systems across cloud, infrastructure, and platform environments.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**About Availity**
 Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real\-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity, so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.
   

  

**About Availity India**
 Availity India is an important part of Availity's global growth journey. Based in Bengaluru, our India teams partner closely with U.S. and global stakeholders across technology, product, operations, customer support, and corporate functions.
   

  

 Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **NOC Senior Engineer** 
 to support 24x7 operations, major incident management, cloud infrastructure support, and operational excellence initiatives. This is a senior hands\-on role responsible for advanced technical troubleshooting, L3 escalations, proactive monitoring, automation, and ensuring the reliability and availability of critical production systems across cloud, infrastructure, and platform environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as the L3 technical escalation point and senior authority for P1/P2 incidents.
* Lead incident triage, stabilization, recovery efforts, and operational restoration during major outages.
* Collaborate with Major Incident Managers, Operations teams, and engineering stakeholders during critical incidents.
* Ensure adherence to SLA, MTTR, and MTTA targets.
* Support and execute incident command processes, escalation control, and stakeholder communication.
* Own proactive monitoring effectiveness across infrastructure, cloud, and platform services.
* Hands\-on experience with monitoring tools, including Splunk, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Grafana, and Prometheus.
* Manage AWS operational environments including EC2, VPC, Route 53, Security Groups, Load Balancers, CloudWatch, EKS, and RDS.
* Support Azure operations, Azure SQL, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics environments.
* Troubleshoot Linux and Windows server environments.
* Support Kubernetes (EKS) infrastructure, containerized workloads, and platform reliability.
* Drive automation and operational efficiency using Terraform, PowerShell, Bash, and Python.
* Participate in RCA reviews, Problem Management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Analyze alert noise, optimize monitoring thresholds, and improve operational visibility.
* Mentor NOC Engineers and provide technical leadership during assigned shifts.
* Ensure operational continuity through structured shift handovers and follow\-the\-sun support models.


**Required Qualifications**
* 7\-10 years of experience in NOC Operations, SRE, Cloud Operations, Infrastructure Support, or Production Support environments.
* Strong experience handling P1/P2 incidents and serving as an advanced technical escalation point.
* Hands\-on operational experience with AWS cloud services.
* Experience supporting Azure infrastructure and services.
* Strong Linux and Windows administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Hands\-on experience with Splunk and enterprise monitoring platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes (EKS), containerized environments, and cloud\-native operations.
* Strong understanding of networking concepts including DNS, Routing, Load Balancing, Firewalls, Security Groups, and Connectivity Troubleshooting.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or equivalent ITSM platforms.
* Automation and scripting experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar technologies.
* Experience working in 24x7 operational environments with rotational shift models.
* Strong communication, technical leadership, and collaboration skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, New Relic, AppDynamics, or Site24x7\.
* Working knowledge of Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, Git, Rundeck, and CI/CD concepts.
* Understanding IAM, cloud security monitoring, vulnerability management, and security incident response.
* Exposure to SRE principles, observability engineering, and reliability practices.
* Experience in Healthcare Technology environments.
* HIPAA awareness and compliance knowledge.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).
* ITIL Foundation Certification.


**Why Join Availity India?**
* Meaningful impact: Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences.
* Global exposure: Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.
* Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.
* Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office\-based models.
* Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.
* Inclusive workplace: Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward.
* Office experience: For office\-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night\-shift transportation support.


**What To Expect From The Hiring Process**
 Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and engaging. Depending on the role, it may include application review, recruiter discussion, technical or functional assessment, hiring manager interviews, team or leadership conversations, offer discussion, background verification, and onboarding support.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
 Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply.
   

  

**Eligibility**
**Video Camera Usage**
*Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera\-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.*
*Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non\-participants.*
